results.content:
What makes ABrush different  
  
ABrush brings 23+ leading AI models directly into Photoshop, so artists can access AI without constantly exporting, switching, downloading, and importing. But being inside Photoshop is only part of it.  
  
It is a creative suite that turns often unpredictable AI generation into a much more controlled and repeatable process. Your style, process, and action sequences can be encoded into reusable workflows.  
  
And this extends across teams. Styles, settings, workflows, and generation libraries can be shared, so a studio can build up its own creative system rather than having every artist start from scratch. [...] Hi Product Hunt! I’m Ivanna Pogrebniak, CEO of ABrush.  
  
Why we built ABrush  
  
We are AB Games, the team behind Hidden City, the 5th title globally in the HOPA genre with more than 90 million players worldwide.  
  
When AI first entered game development, we immediately began looking for ways to best utilize and customize its abilities to improve our industry’s creative processes.  
  
The question for us was always: “How can we reduce the distance between an AI-generated image and production-ready artwork while keeping full creative control in the artists’ hands?”  
  
We built the answer in the form of ABrush. And after three years of internal use across our own production teams, we're very excited to bring it to Product Hunt!
